name: Inma no Tane ~Fukushuu no Shokushu Kan~
original_name: 淫魔の種～復讐の触手姦～
source:
Main character lives a normal life with annoying sister and unfriendly classmates. One night he has a dream about having sex with the classmate he loves and then some voice asks him whether it's what he wants. The next morning protagonist wakes up obsessed with obscenity and having ability to summon tentacles...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与烦人的妹妹和不友好的同学一起过着正常的生活。一天晚上，他梦见与他所爱的同学发生性关系，然后有一个声音问他这是否是他想要的。第二天早上，主角醒来时沉迷于淫秽，并拥有召唤触手的能力……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
